title: v4 Hardening
visual_job: Compact 8-tissue hardening surface with canonical callouts.
safe_claim: v4 covers 8 tissues x 8 classifiers x 4 feature types and reduces cherry-pick risk.
claim_boundary: Do not imply every best-row tissue is significant.

title: Temporal And RRRM Lessons
visual_job: Two-lane temporal confound/recovery plus RRRM single-cell lesson.
safe_claim: Temporal and single-cell analyses expose confounds, recovery patterns, and cell-type lessons.
claim_boundary: Recovery projection is descriptive, not held-out validation evidence.

title: Negative Results
visual_job: Failure-mode slide pairing spatial/brain negative and foundation-model negative/control evidence.
safe_claim: Negative results define benchmark boundaries and failure modes.
claim_boundary: Do not claim universal brain biology absence or universal FM failure.

title: Biological Interpretation
visual_job: Biology interpretation triad: immune/signaling, metabolism/drug-target, consensus marker panel.
safe_claim: Benchmark scores can be connected to biological interpretation layers.
claim_boundary: Interpretation only; no causal proof or treatment recommendation.

title: Human Translation
visual_job: Translation ladder: pathway partial conservation, weak gene/TF transfer, target evidence tiers.
safe_claim: Pathway and target evidence support partial translation potential.
claim_boundary: Not clean gene-level transfer and not a clinical or countermeasure recommendation.
